definitions.gloss: aspiration; accidental inhalation of food or liquid into the airway
definitions.explanation: The unintentional entry of food, liquid, or other material into the trachea and lungs instead of the esophagus. A common medical concern especially among elderly people.

examples.japanese: {誤嚥|ごえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: Elderly people have a high risk of pneumonia caused by aspiration.

examples.english: Cutting food into small pieces can help prevent aspiration.

notes:
Composed of {誤|ご} (mistake, error) and {嚥|えん} (to swallow). The word specifically refers to the accidental entry of food or liquid into the airway rather than the stomach.

{誤嚥|ごえん}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦{肺炎|はいえん}→肺炎：08443_haien⟧ (aspiration pneumonia) is a major health concern in aging societies like Japan, making this term frequently seen in health-related media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誤嚥|ごえん}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦{肺炎|はいえん}→肺炎：08443_haien⟧ (aspiration pneumonia)
- {誤嚥|ごえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent aspiration)
- {誤嚥|ごえん}⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧ (aspiration accident)
- {誤嚥|ごえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスク→リスク：06752_risuku⟧ (risk of aspiration)
